verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents official SDKs across many platforms. These include rollbar.js for server- and client-side JavaScript (React, Angular, Express, Next.js), a .NET SDK with Blazor support and an LTS release track, a Ruby gem, a Magento 2 module and an Apple Unified Logging module. Its API reference states the REST API is used by 'our official SDKs', the product flags out-of-date SDK versions, and llms.txt describes the docs as helping developers install SDKs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of SDK quality, and a documented full list of SDK languages beyond 'over a dozen platforms'.
